evidence: The new SendPingAsync call receives cancellationToken, but its OperationCanceledException reaches catch (Exception) at line 184, which logs a warning and returns false. If the device was already offline, CheckDeviceAsync takes the unchanged-status branch without another cancellation-aware operation, so CheckAllDevicesAsync can return successfully instead of propagating cancellation.
